identity.before: frame-based: ╭┈┈ / ┃ / ╰┈┈ / ⬡ / ✦, emoji-per-category, seven fruit colour themes
identity.after: AXION — geometric marks (◆ ◇ ▸ ▪ ⌁), solid/dashed rules (▰ ╌), chip syntax ⟨ ⟩, mono ordinals, WhatsApp-native emphasis
identity.rule: none of the legacy frame glyphs are reused; asserted by tests

newModules.role: safe Unicode styling; protected-segment detection; strip() for search/compare
semantic glyph tokens, permission badges, processing states, category icons/labels
single source of truth for brand, read from config.ui.identity
registry-driven discovery, permission filter, search, five renderers, cached
renderer/adapter: image+caption with guaranteed text fallback

typographySafety.styledScripts: Latin only (Mathematical Alphanumeric Symbols); Arabic uses WhatsApp *bold* / _italic_ because it has no reliable styled variants
typographySafety.mechanism: segment() marks protected spans via regex and styling skips them entirely
typographySafety.gotchaDocumented: styled text uses different codepoints, so plain-text search will not match it — style.strip() exists for that and is asserted in tests

migrationStrategy.chosen: centralised — migrate the shared response surfaces so all 897 plugins inherit the new identity without being edited
migrationStrategy.rationale: editing 897 files would risk behaviour loss for cosmetic gain; the user-visible strings for every plugin flow through config.messages, maro-formatter and the handler
centralSurfacesMigrated: src/lib/maro-text-style.js — formatTextPanel/commandGuide/statusPanel now delegate to the design system, signatures unchanged
migrationStrategy.notMigrated: per-plugin bespoke strings inside the remaining ~890 plugins still carry their original wording; they now sit on the new shared states/messages but their own literals were intentionally left untouched to guarantee functional parity

featureFlag.loaderVisibility: the loader skips nested directories, so the legacy copies never register or collide
